final: WITH patient_averages AS (SELECT l.ID AS patient_id, p.SEX AS sex, AVG(l.WBC) AS avg_wbc, AVG(l.HGB / l.HCT) AS ratio FROM Laboratory AS l JOIN Patient AS p ON p.ID = l.ID GROUP BY l.ID, p.SEX), overall AS (SELECT AVG(ratio) AS mean_ratio FROM patient_averages) SELECT patient_id, sex, avg_wbc, ratio, ratio - mean_ratio AS difference FROM patient_averages CROSS JOIN overall WHERE ratio > mean_ratio ORDER BY difference DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10
